username.description: The username which is used to access the database.
username.title: User

oneOf.title: Scan Changes with User Defined Cursor
oneOf.description: Incrementally detects new inserts and updates using the cursor column chosen when configuring a connection (e.g. created_at, updated_at).

oneOf.title: Read Changes using Change Data Capture (CDC)
oneOf.description: Recommended - Incrementally reads new inserts, updates, and deletes using MySQL's change data capture feature. This must be enabled on your database.

server_timezone.description: Enter the configured MySQL server timezone. This should only be done if the configured timezone in your MySQL instance does not conform to IANNA standard.
server_timezone.title: Configured server timezone for the MySQL source (Advanced)

invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.description: Determines whether Airbyte should fail or re-sync data in case of an stale/invalid cursor value in the mined logs. If 'Fail sync' is chosen, a user will have to manually reset the connection before being able to continue syncing data. If 'Re-sync data' is chosen, Airbyte will automatically trigger a refresh but could lead to higher cloud costs and data loss.
invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.title: Invalid CDC Position Behavior (Advanced)

initial_load_timeout_hours.description: The amount of time an initial load is allowed to continue for before catching up on CDC logs.
initial_load_timeout_hours.title: Initial Load Timeout in Hours (Advanced)

replication_method.description: Configures how data is extracted from the database.
replication_method.title: Update Method

password.description: The password associated with the username.
password.title: Password

items.description: Inclusion filter configuration for table selection per database.
items.title: Table Filter

database_name.description: The name of the database to apply this filter to. Should match the database defined in the "Database" field above.
database_name.title: Database Name

table_name_patterns.description: List of table name patterns to include. Should be a SQL LIKE pattern.
table_name_patterns.title: Table Filter Patterns

table_filters.description: Optional filters to include only specific tables from the specified database.
table_filters.title: Table Filters

jdbc_url_params.description: Additional properties to pass to the JDBC URL string when connecting to the database formatted as 'key=value' pairs separated by the symbol '&'. (example: key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3).
jdbc_url_params.title: JDBC URL Params

checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) a stream should checkpoint, when possible.
checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.title: Checkpoint Target Time Interval

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent queries to the database.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

max_db_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent queries to the database. Leave empty to let Airbyte optimize performance.
max_db_connections.title: Max Concurrent Queries to Database

check_privileges.description: When this feature is enabled, during schema discovery the connector will query each table or view individually to check access privileges and inaccessible tables, views, or columns therein will be removed. In large schemas, this might cause schema discovery to take too long, in which case it might be advisable to disable this feature.
check_privileges.title: Check Table and Column Access Privileges

treat_tinyint1_as_integer.description: When enabled, TINYINT(1) columns are emitted as integers instead of booleans.
treat_tinyint1_as_integer.title: Treat TINYINT(1) Columns as Integers

oneOf.title: preferred
oneOf.description: To allow unencrypted communication only when the source doesn't support encryption.

oneOf.title: required
oneOf.description: To always require encryption. Note: The connection will fail if the source doesn't support encryption.

oneOf.title: verify_ca
oneOf.description: To always require encryption and verify that the source has a valid SSL certificate.

client_certificate.description: Client certificate (this is not a required field, but if you want to use it, you will need to add the Client key as well)
client_certificate.title: Client certificate File

client_key.description: Client key (this is not a required field, but if you want to use it, you will need to add the Client certificate as well)
client_key.title: Client Key

client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. This field is optional. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.
client_key_password.title: Client key password

oneOf.title: verify_identity
oneOf.description: To always require encryption and verify that the source has a valid SSL certificate.

client_certificate.description: Client certificate (this is not a required field, but if you want to use it, you will need to add the Client key as well)
client_certificate.title: Client certificate File

client_key.description: Client key (this is not a required field, but if you want to use it, you will need to add the Client certificate as well)
client_key.title: Client Key

client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. This field is optional. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.
client_key_password.title: Client key password

ssl_mode.description: The encryption method which is used when communicating with the database.
ssl_mode.title: Encryption

oneOf.title: No Tunnel
oneOf.description: No ssh tunnel needed to connect to database

oneOf.title: SSH Key Authentication
oneOf.description: Connect through a jump server tunnel host using username and ssh key

tunnel_host.description: Hostname of the jump server host that allows inbound ssh tunnel.
tunnel_host.title: SSH Tunnel Jump Server Host

tunnel_port.description: Port on the proxy/jump server that accepts inbound ssh connections.
tunnel_port.title: SSH Connection Port

tunnel_user.description: OS-level username for logging into the jump server host
tunnel_user.title: SSH Login Username

ssh_key.description: OS-level user account ssh key credentials in RSA PEM format ( created with ssh-keygen -t rsa -m PEM -f myuser_rsa )
ssh_key.title: SSH Private Key

oneOf.title: Password Authentication
oneOf.description: Connect through a jump server tunnel host using username and password authentication

tunnel_host.description: Hostname of the jump server host that allows inbound ssh tunnel.
tunnel_host.title: SSH Tunnel Jump Server Host

tunnel_port.description: Port on the proxy/jump server that accepts inbound ssh connections.
tunnel_port.title: SSH Connection Port

tunnel_user.description: OS-level username for logging into the jump server host
tunnel_user.title: SSH Login Username

tunnel_user_password.description: OS-level password for logging into the jump server host
tunnel_user_password.title: Password

tunnel_method.description: Whether to initiate an SSH tunnel before connecting to the database, and if so, which kind of authentication to use.
tunnel_method.title: SSH Tunnel Method
